en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a substantial two‑storey civic-looking building on a dirt street, with tall trees and a simple wooden fence on the left. Several uniformed men stand on the stairs at the main entrance. Large flags hang from poles on the facade, and another flag flies from the roof. The architecture has a Central European late‑19th‑century style with rectangular windows and modest stucco decoration. No text is clearly legible in the image.
